assumptions: Effect.uninterruptible wrapping the per-job Effect inside Stream.mapEffect causes an interrupt signal to be deferred until the current job completes — this is the standard Effect interruption model and the handbook confirms it. Queue.clear on an ended-but-not-fully-drained queue returns the remaining buffered items; the handbook documents clear as 'everything buffered, possibly []' without restricting it to open queues. The finalizer registered via Effect.addFinalizer runs after Stream.runDrain (and after in-flight uninterruptible jobs finish) because Effect's scope-close sequencing waits for outstanding fibers before running finalizers.
